title: Hangman, Samoa Joe & HOOK’s betrayal
summary: Page’s championship run ends inside a cage before the title picture becomes a four-way struggle.

chapters.title: HOOK helps Joe win
chapters.result: Joe defeats Page in a steel cage with help from HOOK.
chapters.context: HOOK reveals that he remains aligned with Joe and the Opps.

chapters.title: MJF wins the four-way
chapters.result: MJF defeats Joe, Page, and Swerve to become champion again.
chapters.context: Joe’s reign ends in a match involving three major rivals.
